name: socratic-method
description: An Agent Skill that makes an AI coding agent cross-examine its own work before it ships: predict-then-run, gated, and mostly silent. One npx command installs it for every tool that reads the Agent Skills format - Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Amp, Roo Code and more.
author: Ergini (https://ergini.com)
